title: Supervisor de manutenção predial
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO:

Supervisiona e realiza trabalhos técnicos e mecânicos que garantem que os ambientes internos e externos dos prédios, terrenos, áreas comuns e comodidades da comunidade atendam aos padrões da Empresa em relação à limpeza, aparência, segurança e funcionalidade geral.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Auxilia e executa ordens de serviço geradas por solicitações dos moradores, bem como manutenção de rotina na comunidade, diagnosticando a origem ou causa do defeito ou problema e realizando os reparos de acordo com as políticas, procedimentos, normas de segurança e exigências do código estabelecidos.

• Supervisiona e conclui o processo de preparação (“make-ready”) das unidades desocupadas para locação e novos moradores, realizando a inspeção pré-desocupação, criando uma lista de manutenção necessária, agendando fornecedores e prestadores de serviço conforme necessário, adquirindo os materiais e suprimentos necessários, realizando todas as tarefas de manutenção e inspecionando o trabalho concluído.

• Desenvolve padrões para a limpeza e aparência geral das áreas externas da comunidade, comodidades, fachadas dos edifícios, interiores das unidades prontas para locação, corredores, calçadas, placas, escritório de locação, áreas centrais de lixo, estacionamentos e outras construções e áreas comuns, garantindo que reflitam a alta qualidade da comunidade e os padrões da Greystar.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por outros membros da equipe de manutenção para avaliar a eficácia das políticas e procedimentos e desenvolver planos de ação corretiva conforme necessário.

• Inspeciona periodicamente o trabalho realizado por empreiteiros, fornecedores e outros prestadores de serviços para verificar se os serviços, materiais e mão de obra atendem aos padrões de qualidade, escopo e especificações exigidas.

• Mantém inventário adequado de peças de reposição e materiais de manutenção, trabalhando com o Gerente da Comunidade para encomendar suprimentos e ferramentas conforme necessário, respeitando os limites orçamentários.

• Executa os procedimentos de manutenção preventiva mensalmente conforme descrito no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoia programas de economia e controle de despesas consertando, sempre que possível, ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdício de materiais e suprimentos e utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos corretamente.

• Realiza reuniões regulares de segurança da Greystar, garante que todas as fichas MSDS estejam atualizadas e acessíveis, e mantém-se informado sobre todas as exigências e legislações de segurança da OSHA e outras entidades para garantir a conformidade da comunidade.


CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem fornecer suas próprias ferramentas manuais, salvo quando proibido pela legislação estadual, e devem ter conhecimento e habilidades no uso e manutenção seguros de ferramentas manuais, elétricas, equipamentos mecânicos e dispositivos de medição.

• Capacidade demonstrada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para definir e corrigir problemas.

• Proficiência em atendimento ao cliente e habilidades de comunicação interpessoal para interagir eficazmente com moradores, clientes, colegas de equipe e outros contatos profissionais, respondendo com cortesia a perguntas e solicitações e mantendo a calma ao lidar com problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz para representar a gestão da empresa em funções de apoio, atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para colegas de equipe internos e visitantes externos, e responder a perguntas relacionadas às políticas operacionais do departamento.

• Proficiência demonstrada em programas de internet, processamento de texto, planilhas e gerenciamento de banco de dados para manter registros e desenvolver informações para uso do gestor. (Experiência com sistemas de gestão imobiliária é preferida.)

• Capacidade de operar máquinas básicas de escritório, como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de selos postais e sistemas telefônicos com várias linhas.

• Habilidades matemáticas necessárias para somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir números, decimais e frações para revisar e preencher documentos financeiros, administrativos e legais.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.


LICENÇAS OU CERTIFICAÇÕES EXIGIDAS:

• Os ocupantes do cargo devem possuir todas as certificações exigidas pelas jurisdições estaduais e locais.


VIAGENS / EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Os membros da equipe trabalham em ambiente de escritório ou remoto. Nenhuma exigência física especial é necessária.

• Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser exigidas para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias para o cumprimento de algumas ou todas as responsabilidades diárias deste cargo.


Sobre a Greystar

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, oferecendo expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para locação de padrão institucional, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul, a Greystar gerencia e opera mais de US$ 290 bilhões em imóveis em 247 mercados globalmente, com escritórios em toda a América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região da Ásia-Pacífico. A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, administra mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos em todo o mundo e possui uma robusta plataforma institucional de gestão de investimentos, com mais de US$ 76 bilhões em ativos sob gestão, incluindo mais de US$ 34 bilhões em ativos em desenvolvimento. A Greystar foi fundada por Bob Faith em 1993 com o objetivo de se tornar uma prestadora de serviços de classe mundial no setor imobiliário residencial para locação. Para saber mais, acesse .

title: PMO - Desenvolvimento de Negócios
description:
A Química Anastacio é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos químicos da América Latina e oferece um amplo portfólio de produtos e ingredientes, além de soluções e serviços inteligentes, auxiliando os clientes e fornecedores no crescimento dos seus negócios. Contamos com uma excelente estrutura comercial, logística e técnica, e atendemos todas as indústrias do mercado.


Nos últimos anos, fortalecemos nossas operações transformando em ágil, simples e focada no cliente. Hoje temos 6 centros de distribuições localizados estrategicamente no Brasil, presença na Argentina e México, com meta de expandir nossa participação no mercado da América Latina e representamos cerca de 400 fornecedores globais.


Para mais informações, visite


Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de desenvolvimento de negócios: novos produtos, fornecedores, segmentos e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Avaliar e implantar softwares e métodos de gestão de projetos, assegurando documentação estruturada e padronização de processos.
  • Promover reuniões de acompanhamento (diárias, semanais e mensais) com as equipes envolvidas, garantindo alinhamento e ritmo nas entregas.
  • Implantar e aprimorar ferramentas de gestão de projetos e governanças corporativas que garantam análises de viabilidade técnicas e financeiras de forma ágil e padronizada.
  • Estruturar e treinar os stakeholders em metodologias de projeto, governança e ferramentas de acompanhamento.
  • Liderar o calendário de business reports , consolidando resultados, impacto financeiro, desvios críticos e aprendizados.
  • Definir e aplicar critérios de priorização de projetos , criando uma matriz de decisão estratégica e coordenando fóruns de go/no go.
  • Construir e monitorar o pipeline de projetos , com SLAs e indicadores de eficiência (tempo, esforço, retorno, margem).
  • Mapear recursos necessários (financeiros, humanos e técnicos) e propor otimizações de alocação.
  • Estruturar o pool de oportunidades da companhia, centralizando ideias, mensurando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Coordenar o Comitê LATAM , garantindo integração de governança com México e Argentina.


Formação:

  • Graduação completa (Administração, Engenharia, Química ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações (PMP, Scrum Master, Lean, PM², etc.) são diferenciais.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de portfólio de projetos , preferencialmente em empresas B2B industriais, químicas ou de distribuição.
  • Vivência em implantação de PMO , gestão de performance e estruturação de governança.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para conectar estratégia, operação e resultado financeiro .
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para conduzir fóruns executivos multidisciplinares.


Local de trabalho : Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira das 8h00 às 17h45

title: Analista Pl - Qualidade (Auditoria) - Pesquisa Nacional - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.


Requisitos

A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos em conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.


  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Pesquisa Clínica, Gestão da Qualidade ou Auditoria em Saúde;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura e escrita técnica);
  • Espanhol técnico para interface com centros da América Latina;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Boas Práticas Clínicas (ICH-GCP);
  • Familiaridade com a legislação brasileira aplicável (RDC 9/2015, Res. CNS 466/2012, Res. CNS 510/2016);
  • Vivência prévia em auditorias de pesquisa clínica;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias internacionais (FDA, EMA, PMDA);
  • Desejável conhecimento de sistemas eletrônicos (eTMF, CTMS, EDC, eISF);
  • Certificações adicionais desejáveis: Auditor Líder ISO, SOCRA, ACRP ou DIA.


Atividades

  • Planejar, executar e reportar auditorias em centros de pesquisa, patrocinadores e CROs;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com classificação de achados e definição de planos de ação;
  • Monitorar a implementação de CAPAs (ações corretivas e preventivas) e avaliar sua eficácia;
  • Apoiar a manutenção e atualização de procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs);
  • Ministrar treinamentos internos sobre Boas Práticas Clínicas (ICH-GCP) e conformidade regulatória;
  • Contribuir para a preparação e acompanhamento de inspeções nacionais (ANVISA, CONEP) e internacionais (FDA, EMA);
  • Participar da análise de indicadores de qualidade e geração de relatórios gerenciais.


Outras Informações

  • Jardim Paulista - SP;
  • Segunda a quinta-feira das 8h às 18h e sexta-feira das 8h às 17h - 100% Presencial.

title: Nutricionista
description:

  • Acompanhar as condições das áreas de refeição, zelando pela limpeza, conforto e conservação dos espaços.
  • Apoiar ações de sustentabilidade, como redução de desperdício de alimentos e uso consciente de recursos.
  • Gerir contratos e relacionamento com fornecedores, garantindo o cumprimento das normas técnicas e cláusulas acordadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e operacionais, apresentando resultados e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de facilities, integrando o serviço de alimentação às demais áreas (limpeza, manutenção, segurança, etc.).

Perfil desejado:

  • Formação completa em Nutrição

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.


What You'll Do


Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives


Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency


Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies

O supervisor de vendas (Associate Sales Manager) é responsável por supervisionar a gestão das equipes que dão suporte às contas para impulsionar a geração de receita e o crescimento dos negócios, liderar uma equipe de vendas, ser responsável por impulsionar o desempenho da equipe por meio de ações de sucesso do cliente (integração, adoção, verificações de integridade e voz do cliente) e/ou ações de retenção de receita (renovações de contratos de produtos/serviços, extensão, upsell e expansão). Responsável por gerenciar, construir e desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes por meio de um nível equilibrado de envolvimento com o diretor de vendas e clientes externos.


Objetivo do cargo:

Supervisionar e orientar uma equipe de associados de aquisição de clientes para atingir as metas de vendas da empresa no espaço B2B brasileiro. Isso envolve planejamento estratégico, orientação e apoio direto para garantir o sucesso da equipe.


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Liderar, treinar e orientar uma equipe de associados focada na aquisição de novos clientes empresariais no Brasil.

  • Coordenar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir uma experiência de integração perfeita para novos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em uma função de vendas.
  • Mais de 1 ano de experiência em liderança em uma função de vendas semelhante é importante.
  • Sólido conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado brasileiro, particularmente no setor de mídia social e tecnologia.
  • Proficiência em português e inglês (B2+/C1), com excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.
  • Morar em São Paulo - SP e ter fácil acesso a unidade da Concentrix Barra funda.

Modelo Híbrido – (3x semana presencial Bairro Bela Vista, São Paulo/SP 2x semana Home Office)

title: Tech Lead (Conversational Solutions)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.



Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.



Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.


  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Account Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

The Account Manager team is responsible for maintaining and establishing the relationship between sellers and SHEIN, helping them to improve their sales. You will be part of an exciting team that provides support and guidance to sellers, ensuring mutual growth and success.


This role will be based in our office in São Paulo/Faria Lima.


Responsabilities:

● Responsible for improving sales and number of orders for all managed sellers they assist

● Responsible for establishing and maintaining a good relationship with fashion sellers, monitoring sales and operation

● Help the sellers to select SKUs for various campaigns and promotions

● Prepare reports and provide detailed information about assisted sellers to category managers in order to execute defined strategies

● Research the fashion market and do competitive analysis


Qualifications:

● Bachelor's degree or above

● Sales aptitude and ambition to constantly surpass your KPIs

● Experience in managing market place partners

● Logical and problem-oriented thinking

● Good analytical skill

● Excellent communication skills

● Microsoft Excel domain

● Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

● Experience in Marketplace is a plus


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Gerente de ventas trilingue (Español, Inglés, Portugués)
description:
El supervisor de ventas (Gerente de Ventas) es responsable de supervisar la gestión de los equipos que dan soporte a las cuentas para impulsar la generación de ingresos y el crecimiento del negocio, liderar un equipo de ventas, ser responsable de impulsar el rendimiento del equipo a través de acciones de éxito del cliente (integración, adopción, verificaciones de integridad y voz del cliente) y/o acciones de retención de ingresos (renovaciones de contratos de productos/servicios, ampliación, ventas adicionales y expansión). Es responsable de gestionar, construir y desarrollar relaciones estratégicas con los clientes a través de un nivel equilibrado de implicación con el director de ventas y los clientes externos.


Objetivo del puesto:

Supervisar y orientar a un equipo de asociados de adquisición de clientes para alcanzar los objetivos de ventas de la empresa en el ámbito B2B de paises de LATAM (en español). Esto implica planificación estratégica, orientación y apoyo directo para garantizar el éxito del equipo.


Sus responsabilidades:

  • Dirigir, capacitar y orientar a un equipo de asociados enfocado en la adquisición de nuevos clientes empresariales en LATAM (paises que hablan español).
  • Desarrollar estrategias de adquisición integrales adaptadas al entorno empresarial brasileño.
  • Establecer relaciones sólidas con clientes y partes interesadas importantes.
  • Hacer un seguimiento y analizar las métricas de adquisición para perfeccionar las estrategias y mejorar los resultados.
  • Coordinar con equipos multifuncionales para garantizar una experiencia de integración perfecta para los nuevos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Más de tres años de experiencia demostrable en un puesto de ventas.
  • Es importante contar con más de 1 año de experiencia en liderazgo en un puesto similar en ventas.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de la dinámica del mercado de paises de LATAM (que hablan español), especialmente en el sector de las redes sociales y la tecnología.
  • Dominio del español y el inglés (B2+/C1), con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo.
  • Residir en São Paulo (SP) y tener fácil acceso a la unidad de Concentrix Barra Funda.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio-creche
  • Convênios e descontos comerciais
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber


Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVER

O que você vai fazer:


  • Acompanhar as mudanças nas legislações trabalhistas, previdenciárias, tributárias e convenções, lendo e contatando as áreas de consultoria jurídica e RH, com a finalidade de modificar procedimentos, solicitar e validar parâmetros e cálculos sistemáticos;

  • Realizar e analisar rateios, provisões de salários e benefícios (definidos por regras e determinações de RH e Sindicatos), avaliando os critérios com as áreas de apoio (RH, Contabilidade e Planejamento);

  • Realizar, atuar e apoiar as migrações de folha de empresas adquiridas;
  • Realizar múltiplas demandas e atividades de média complexidade de Adm Gente, relacionadas a cálculos, processamentos sistêmicos, atividades de Auditoria e obrigações legais, motivadas por situações que comprometem os prazos e sobreamentos de processos.


O que esperamos de você:

title: IT 主管
description:
About the Role

The Local IT Supervisor will lead all IT operations for Jetour Brazil , ensuring system stability, efficiency, and compliance.

This position serves as the key technical bridge between Jetour’s China Headquarters and the Brazil subsidiary , supporting system rollout, integration, and daily operations across SAP, DMS, WMS, CRM, and NF-e environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain local IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, VPN, cloud services, printers, and end-user devices.
  • Support and monitor enterprise systems such as SAP, DMS, WMS, CRM, and TMS; resolve first-line issues and escalate to HQ when necessary.
  • Ensure NF-e / NFS-e tax and fiscal integrations comply with Brazilian regulations.
  • Coordinate with local departments (Finance, Sales, Logistics, After-sales) to ensure system reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Liaise with local IT vendors and HQ technical teams for network, security, and system upgrades.
  • Implement IT policies, user access controls, data backups, and security measures in accordance with HQ standards and LGPD requirements.
  • Participate in system rollouts, user training, and acceptance testing.
  • Provide regular reports on system health, incidents, and improvement actions.

Required Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of IT operations experience, preferably within automotive, manufacturing, or logistics industries .
  • Hands-on experience with SAP (or similar ERP) , DMS, WMS, or CRM systems.
  • Familiarity with NF-e / NFS-e tax compliance , network infrastructure , and endpoint management .
  • Proven experience coordinating with cross-functional teams and managing local IT vendors .

Skills:

  • Proficient in Windows Server , Microsoft 365 , and Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) .
  • Familiar with FortiGate firewalls , UniFi switches , VPN configuration , and cloud environments .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and network layers.
  • Knowledge of endpoint protection tools (e.g., WithSecure Elements) and Microsoft Intune .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation or IT projects within the automotive industry .

Please submit your resume in English .

title: Regulador de Sinistros Pleno  - Linhas Financeiras
description:
Cargo: Regulador de Sinistros Pleno

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Significa ter flexibilidade e tempo para todas as coisas que são importantes para você. É uma oportunidade de fazer algo significativo todos os dias. É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.

Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.


OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Administrar a regulação de sinistro, seguindo todas as etapas do processo (documentação, elaboração de relatórios, realização de pericias, avaliação de apólice), diagnosticando os prejuízos envolvidos e o ressarcimento com base na apólice do segurado.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

1. Administrar e conduzir regulações de sinistros desde a abertura, com análise prévia do local e documentos, participando as partes envolvidas, realizando reuniões, solicitando documentação e/ou perícia, analisando coberturas de apólices e laudos, apurando prejuízos e emitindo os relatórios de regulação.

2. Suportar necessidades administrativas e solicitações das corretoras, operadoras e clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas, disponibilizando e/ou solicitando documentos conforme necessidade.

4. Alimentar o sistema, inserindo documentos, e-mails, relatórios, vistorias e perícias (fotos, atas, conclusões), horas trabalhadas (time sheet), acompanhando os alertas do sistema com relação aos prazos e resultados do ranking.

5. Monitorar status dos sinistros de acordo com a parametrização estabelecida pela empresa e controlada pela Administração da Regulação.

6. Solicitar aprovação de faturamento parcial, intermediário ou final, enviando para a seguradora a prévia do time sheet com resumo das despesas e honorários e disparando e-mail para o financeiro faturar mediante aprovação da seguradora.


EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA

Mínimo de 3 ano de experiência na regulação de sinistros em linhas financeiras .


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia ou Direito .


CONHECIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS

  • Contrato e legislação de seguros
  • RCG – Responsabilidade Civil Geral
  • RCP – Responsabilidade Civil Profissional
  • Conhecimento prático em D&O e E&O
  • Noções de cálculos
  • Lançamentos contábeis
  • Negociação
  • Conhecimento jurídico e tributário


IDIOMAS

Inglês é desejável para a posição.

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.


SE#

Participará desde a concepção de novas soluções até o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento e validação com stakeholders internos e externos.


Você atuará de forma próxima às squads, ajudando a traduzir estratégias em histórias de usuário, validando hipóteses e assegurando que cada entrega contribua para os objetivos de produto e negócio.

  • Analisar métricas de produto e propor melhorias contínuas baseadas em dados e feedbacks.
  • Garantir a comunicação eficiente entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Requisitos



  • Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência (profissional ou acadêmica) em gestão de projetos, produto ou análise de requisitos .
  • Conhecimento prático de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) .
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Trello, Notion, ClickUp ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em clareza e colaboração.
  • Noções de ciclo de vida de software e integração entre times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Diferenciais

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

The Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing the health and safety function across all mining sites and projects in our South American Operations region. This role ensures the effective implementation of corporate health and safety strategy, drives continuous improvement, and fosters a proactive safety culture aligned with Pan American Silver’s commitment to “Doing Safety Differently”. The Director collaborates closely with site leadership, Corporate health and safety (H&S), and project teams to prevent serious injuries and fatalities - SIFs, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote best practices.


Reports to: Vice President, Health & Safety.

Location: Residence in South America is required.

Travel: 30–40% annually to operating and development sites, often at high altitudes or remote regions in South America.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in health and safety leadership roles within the mining industry, including site operations in South America.
  • Proven experience implementing Safety Management Systems and ensuring compliance with international and local health and safety regulations.
  • Advanced expertise in risk analysis, incident investigation (e.g., ICAM) and implementation of Critical Control Management (e.g., FRM, CRM, etc.).
  • Strong problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline (e.g., Industrial Safety, Environmental Science, Mining Engineering, Geoscience, Social Science).

Other Requirements

title: Dealer Development Specialist
description:
We are hiring for one of our clients a leading manufacturer of bikes, Qutes ＆ electric 3-wheeler


Job Title: Dealer Development Manager

Base Location: Sao Paulo


Experience Requirement : 5 years of relevant experience in Dealer Development, Network Expansion, and Automotive Retail Operations with exposure to dealer audits, process improvement, and profitability management.


Role Type: Individual Contributor


Role Purpose: To drive dealer network effectiveness, profitability, and readiness by ensuring process excellence, systems standardization, and continuous capability enhancement across all dealerships. The role will be pivotal in shaping the of dealer network, ensuring strong process discipline and sustainable business growth.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Dealer Network Development & Performance

· Drive network planning and coverage expansion, ensuring strategic presence across markets to maximize business potential.

· Design and implement workshops aligned with corporate identity (CI) norms, optimizing dealer infrastructure and service readiness.

· Conduct periodic dealer performance reviews to assess business health, profitability, and customer experience outcomes.

· Identify underperforming dealerships, recommend improvement plans, and oversee implementation through cross-functional collaboration.

· Strengthen dealer capability through structured engagement, capability-building, and performance enhancement programs.

· Partner with field teams to ensure uniform brand experience across all customer touchpoints such as sales and aftersales.

2. Systems, Processes & Operational Excellence

· Establish and standardize systems, processes, and review mechanisms across all dealerships and regions to ensure consistent operations and governance.

· Implement and monitor business analytics and intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making and profitability tracking at dealerships.

· Lead process improvement and re-engineering initiatives to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and dealer–customer experience.

· Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) from within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.

· Audit dealerships to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain performance and compliance.

· Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.


Key Interfaces:

Internal Stakeholders:

· Field Sales Teams

· Service Teams

· Finance

· Legal

External Stakeholders:

· Dealership Owners and Management Teams


Impact & Contribution:

· Direct impact on dealer profitability, customer experience, and market performance.

· Strengthens network capability by ensuring standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.

· Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

  • Pacote Office: Excel, Word e PowerPoint Avançado para análise de dados e apresentações.
  • Diferencial: inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança


Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 33 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 8.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


A BNP Paribas Cardif tem um papel essencial na vida dos clientes segurados, fornecendo soluções econômicas que permitem a realização de objetivos com a proteção contra eventos inesperados. Como uma empresa comprometida, a BNP Paribas Cardif se esforça para ter um impacto positivo na sociedade e contribuir para que os seguros sejam acessíveis ao maior número de pessoas possível.


No Brasil, somos uma das maiores especialistas em seguros massificados. Temos um portfólio de produtos diversificado, com destaque para: prestamista, garantia estendida (inclusive veicular), roubo e furto qualificado de portáveis com quebra acidental.


Somos uma seguradora B2B2C, ou seja, temos um modelo de negócio baseado em parcerias, em que nossos seguros são distribuídos para os clientes por meio da rede de grandes empresas brasileiras, divididas nos principais mercados: VAREJO, BANCOS e DIGITAL.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

Title : Senior Manager, Engineering Operations

Level : Manager or Senior Manager

Location : Brazil

office once we open an office next year

Department : Engineering


Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Head of Engineering, Engineering Operations to lead our

engineering operations which includes areas such DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE),

CI/CD, Release management etc for our cloud-based systems and applications. This role is

pivotal in ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and availability of our systems while driving

innovation in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and operational efficiency. You will be responsible for

crisis management, improving system performance, cost and fostering a culture of operational

excellence.


Responsibilities

● Leadership and strategy

○ Lead and mentor teams in DevOps, SRE, and Engineering Operations, fostering

a culture of collaboration, ownership, and innovation.○ Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for engineering operations, aligning

with business goals and product requirements.

○ Advocate for and implement industry best practices in system reliability, DevOps,

and automation.

● Reliability and availability

○ Drive initiatives to improve the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud-

based applications and infrastructure.

○ Establish performance measurements for various system health metrics.

○ Ensure robust incident management and crisis response processes to minimize

downtime and customer impact.

● DevOps and CI/CD

○ Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines to

enable seamless and automated deployment processes.

○ Leverage automation tools and practices to reduce manual interventions and

improve operational efficiency.

○ Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enable rapid and reliable

feature delivery.

● Monitoring and observability

○ Implement and maintain advanced monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to

gain deep insights into system health and performance.

○ Use observability tools (e.g., Grafana) to proactively identify and resolve issues

before they impact customers.

● Crisis and Incident Management

○ Lead crisis management efforts during high-severity incidents, ensuring quick

resolution and effective communication with stakeholders.

○ Conduct root cause analyses and drive post-mortem reviews to identify and

address operational gaps.

● Team Development and Collaboration

○ Build, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering operations team with

expertise in DevOps and SRE practices across multiple geolocations.

○ Foster close collaboration with development, data, and product teams to align

engineering operations with overall business objectives.

○ Promote a blameless post-mortem culture to encourage continuous learning and

improvement.

● Cost Optimization and Security

○ Optimize cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining system reliability and

scalability.

○ Implement robust security practices in operations to ensure compliance with

industry standards and regulations.


Qualifications

● 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years in leadership roles

● Proven track record of improving system reliability, availability, and performance for

cloud-based applications.

● Extensive experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

● Demonstrated expertise in crisis management and incident response in high-pressure

environments.

● Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS) and container orchestration tools

(Kubernetes, Docker).

● Strong proficiency in monitoring and observability tools like Grafana.

● Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

● Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence

stakeholders across engineering and business teams.

● Proven ability to lead and grow high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

● A strong focus on fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and operational

excellence.

● Influence partner engineering teams like platform and product engineering.

About Whale TV

Whale TV is an independent TV operating system that makes TVs smart and simple to use. Since its inception in 2011, the company has worked with 400+ TV brands and enables 43M+ monthly active TVs around the world to help consumers discover, find and watch their favorite entertainment. With its easy-to-use TV OS, the company connects consumers, TV brands, content providers and advertisers. Whale TV is headquartered in Singapore and has teams collaborating across the globe to make TV better for everyone.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking an Ad Sales Specialist to grow our ad revenue by helping advertisers and demand partners reach consumers in Brazil and LATAM.


Role Overview

As the lead Ad Sales Specialist for the company in Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for driving all ad revenue in the region. You will work with Whale TV Ads leadership to define the ad sales strategy for the region, establish strong relationships with the key demand partners and advertisers, establish then meet or exceed revenue goals for Brazil and each country that has a significant Whale TV presence. You will work with colleagues in other Whale TV departments including Ad Ops, Marketing, Content Partnerships, Finance, and others to garner their support in reaching your regional revenue goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage relationships with Brazil and LATAM-based agencies, brand advertisers, and trading desks looking to advertise in the region
  • Source ad sales opportunities, create sales proposals and close deals for ad inventory sales
  • Create ad revenue forecasts, goals and targets for ad sales in Brazil and LATAM then regularly report on actuals vs. plan.
  • Work closely with Whale TV’s global inventory, operations, and marketing teams to tailor solutions that match client goals
  • Represent Whale TV at key Brazil and LATAM ad industry events
  • Provide ongoing client support, campaign insights, and upsell opportunities for Brazil and LATAM advertisers and their agencies


Qualifications

  • 3-6 years in digital ad sales or media partnerships, with a focus on Brazil and other LATAM markets
  • Proven track record of hitting revenue targets in advertising sales
  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, CTV/OTT, and media selling
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English
  • Self-starter with excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Comfortable working independently and across time zones


Why Join Whale TV?

·      Help building the future of global CTV advertising

·      Work with a collaborative international team

·      Access to premium global inventory and innovative ad formats

·      Competitive salary + commission

title: Operations Manager
description:

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil. Work from office.

Office location: near Santo Amaro Station / Giovani Gronchi. Sao Paulo | Brazil – CENESP

Salary: BRL 10,000/month- BRL 12,000/month


The Operations Manager of a contact center oversees daily operations, manages staff, and ensures high-quality customer service while optimizing efficiency and performance metrics.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee Daily Operations: Manage the overall operations of the contact center, ensuring that all processes run smoothly and efficiently.
  • Staff Management: Supervise, train, and mentor customer service representatives, providing feedback and coaching to improve performance.
  • Performance Monitoring: Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of operations and implement strategies for improvement.

  • Budget Management: Manage the contact center budget, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively to meet operational needs.
  • Process Improvement: Develop and implement operational procedures to optimize efficiency and productivity within the contact center.
  • Technology Implementation: Drive the adoption of technology solutions to enhance contact center performance and streamline operations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless customer service experience and address any operational challenges.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience: 10-15 years of proven experience as a Contact Center Operations Manager or in a similar role within customer service.
  • Leadership Skills: Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to effectively manage and motivate a team.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and trends to make informed decisions and drive performance improvements.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with contact center technologies and software to manage operations effectively.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities to address issues quickly and efficiently.


Work Environment:

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control , establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.


2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.


Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

title: Operations Manager
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others.


We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the Role


As Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo’s battery swapping network — the heart of our customer experience. You will oversee 24/7 operations across hundreds of swap stations, leading teams that keep our infrastructure, field logistics, and data systems running at scale. This is not a back-office role: it’s hands-on, mission-critical, and fundamental to shaping how Latin America moves.


Responsibilities


  • Lead and guide our LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure teams, building a culture of urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Map, design, and scale operational processes to reduce costs, increase efficiency, and prepare for 10x growth.
  • Be responsible for the network’s uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Define and track core KPIs (uptime, SLAs, maintenance cost, SOC, CSAT) using dashboards and data analysis.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the operational voice for Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback for hardware and software design.
  • Guide network expansion decisions (site selection, installation, and launch playbooks).
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, lead post-mortems, and prevent recurrence.


Requirements


  • +5-8 years experience in managing physical operations, field services, logistics, or technical infrastructure,
  • Strong people leadership; ability to motivate diverse, field-based teams.
  • Data-driven decision-making, with experience using analytics tools (Metabase, Tableau, etc.).
  • Skill in process design, optimization, and creation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Ability to solve problems calmly and decisively under pressure.
  • Pragmatic “owner” mindset (extreme ownership) — equally comfortable in the field and in strategic discussions.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to align technology teams, executives, and field personnel.
  • Technical curiosity — an engineer or operator at heart — with a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data really work.


Bonus Points if You Have:


  • Experience in high-growth startups.
  • Background in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications.
  • Experience managing 24/7 mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware operations, maintenance cycles, or supply chain management.
  • Basic SQL knowledge for independent analysis.


Benefits


  • Manage a vital area in a fast-growing startup transforming the future of mobility in Latin America, backed by top-tier venture capital investors.
  • Opportunity to work in a mission-driven company — reducing carbon emissions and empowering underserved populations.
  • Be part of a talented, ambitious, and collaborative team that’s building something big.
  • Autonomy and freedom to take on high-impact responsibilities and grow fast.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Equity participation — the opportunity to own a piece of the company.
  • Health insurance.
